risks.risk: Internal lens elements may have fungus, scratches, or haze not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the front and rear lens elements under bright light, or a video showing the lens being rotated to inspect for haze or scratches.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially defective or requiring cleaning/haze removal

risks.risk: The lens may not be functional (e.g., autofocus, manual focus, or electronic shutter issues).
risks.proof: A video showing the lens being focused and zoomed, or a test shot taken with the lens.

risks.risk: The lens may be missing accessories (e.g., tripod cap, cleaning cloth, or mounting bracket).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the lens.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually on the inside of the hood or near the mount.
A video showing the lens being focused and zoomed, or a test shot taken with the lens.
A close-up photo of the front and rear lens elements under bright light.
A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the lens.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
